what_it_is.prose: Parker Hannifin's Aerospace Group (Parker Aerospace) is a US supplier of hydraulic systems, flight-control actuation, fuel and fluid systems, pneumatics and wheels & brakes. Its hardware is embedded as components within Western aircraft operated by India, but Parker acts as a sub-tier supplier through OEM supply chains rather than through any discrete, publicly documented India defence contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card.
